Title: Create Authentication Flow Diagram for Identity Server Implementation

Description:
We currently have implemented authentication with Identity Server in our system, but the process is not well-documented. To improve understanding and make it easier for new developers to onboard, we should create a flow diagram that outlines the different endpoints involved in the authentication process.

Steps to reproduce:

1. Review the current implementation of authentication with Identity Server
2. Identify all the endpoints involved in the process
3. Create a flow diagram that illustrates the flow of authentication, including the different endpoints and how they interact with each other
4. Add the diagram to our documentation
5. Review and verify the accuracy of the diagram

Acceptance Criteria:

* A clear and easy to understand flow diagram is created
* The diagram illustrates all the endpoints involved in the authentication process
* The diagram is added to our documentation and easily accessible for team members
* The accuracy of the diagram is verified by at least one team member.

This JIRA task aims to improve the understandability of how the authentication process works and make it easy for new team members to understand and maintain it.
